steps.message: Evaluate three separate allocations: 800 TOPS to W7; 800 TOPS to W4; and 300 versus 301 TOPS in one batch to W8.

reply.answer:
**Results (start 2026-04-01, course data):**

| Allocation | Outcome |
|---|---|
| 800 TOPS → W7 OldMill | Not possible — W7 is not ACTIVE and cannot take new work. |
| 800 TOPS → W4 Little Loom | Not possible — W4 does not make TOPS. |
| 300 TOPS → W8 FreshStart | Feasible: 3 workdays + 2 transport days, completion 5 Apr 2026; external charge 300.0 (currency unspecified); rework chance 4% (full-redo scenario arrival 10 Apr); low risk. |
| 301 TOPS → W8 FreshStart | Not possible in one batch — W8's per-batch cap is 300 pieces. |

So only the 300-piece W8 batch works as stated; the other three need a different workshop, category or split batch. Source: workshops.csv profiles via the estimate tools.

Assumptions: new batches, quoted from current workshop capacity/queues, transport and rework charges excluded.

flags: on trial: batches of at most 300 pieces

assumptions: Each workshop's batch needs rework independently, with its defect_rate from workshops.csv.
A rework delays only that workshop's pieces; other batches arrive as planned.

Actual rework duration is not in the data. The full-redo scenario assumes the whole batch is redone once at the same workshop and capacity with no new queue, then adds the fixed transport overhead again. It is not a guaranteed latest arrival; actual delays may be longer.
In-house work has no defect data and is not included.
risk.risk_basis: chance that some outsourced batch needs rework
risk.summary: Low-risk strategy. 96% chance every outsourced batch comes back clean. W8 FreshStart (300 pieces): 4% chance of rework; the full-redo scenario puts their arrival on 10 Apr instead of 5 Apr. Actual rework time is unknown. Scenario dates assume one full redo, unchanged capacity, no new queue and fixed transport; actual arrivals may be later.

assumptions: New batches only; each branch delivers finished goods and runs in parallel.
Monday to Saturday are workdays for all producers; no holidays are modeled.
The start date is inclusive: one workday starting Monday finishes Monday.
External queue and production are rounded up together to whole workdays; transport is added once as calendar days after production.

Dates assume every outsourced batch comes back clean; `risk` gives, batch by batch, the chance of rework and its full-redo scenario arrival date under stated assumptions, not a guaranteed latest date.
Capacity, queues and reference unfinished-order load are from 2026-04-01, even when the scenario starts later.
Reported cost includes external per-piece processing charges only. In-house cost is excluded by request; transport and rework charges are not supplied.
Currency is unspecified in the source data.
Queue and profile values use the 2026-04-01 snapshot even for other scenario dates.

result.message: W8 exceeds its per-batch cap of 300.
